titel: Setting up the online page at your web host
kurz: With the online page you answer questions, approve and pause – on the go, on your phone. It lives at your web host and shows what the PC uploads to the online storage.
brauchst: The online storage: set up, with sync switched on (help “Create the online store at Turso”).
A web host with PHP 8.1 or newer (extensions curl and mbstring) and HTTPS, ideally a subdomain of its own.
An authenticator app on your phone (for the second factor).

schritte.text: The online page is on the internet: under Settings › Operating mode, “Cloud” must be chosen.

At your host, set up a Git deployment from the AMW repository (or your fork), branch `web`, into the folder of the subdomain. Without Git: upload the contents of the `web/` folder. Switch on HTTPS (SSL) for the subdomain.
Open the address in the browser. As long as the page is not set up, its setup assistant appears.
In the assistant, enter the address and key of the online storage – the same as on the PC. The page checks the connection.
Choose a user name (4–40 characters) and a password (at least 14 characters, twice).
Scan the QR code with the authenticator app and confirm the first number. The assistant expires after 30 minutes; after 5 wrong numbers it starts over.

schritte.titel: Enter the address on the PC
schritte.text: Settings › Online site › “Address of the online page”, then save. “Page reachable?” checks whether it answers over https.

werte: Address and key (in the page’s assistant)
the same as under Settings › Storage and sync
you choose them – ideally the password comes from a password manager
Address of the online page (on the PC)
the address of your subdomain, starting with `https://`
fehler: The page is already set up; you get the login instead.
Note “the next deployment deletes the configuration”
The page was not allowed to store its configuration outside the deployment folder. Allow writing one level above the folder at your host and repeat the setup.
The page shows old or no data
The PC is not uploading: sync on? Watcher running? `amw web status` shows the last upload.
An older version or a different page is there. Renew the deployment.
danach: What you do online lands in a mailbox; the PC collects it and carries it out as the developer.
Sign-out after idle time and lockout after failed attempts are set under Settings › Online site.
Set up a second factor at your host, Git provider and storage provider too: whoever takes over one of these accounts can act in your name.
fragen: Can someone else set up a freshly deployed page?
Only someone who has the key of the online storage – without it the assistant does not get past the first step.
How do I switch the online page off?
On the PC: Settings › Storage and sync › sync off. To lock it completely: empty the folder at your host or block reading and writing at the storage provider.
